editorial:
Imagine you are a young girl named Kim who is still heartbroken over her mom passing away. Just as you are trying to heal, your dad brings home a new woman named Na and tells you they are getting married. It sounds like a fresh start, but the vibe in the house turns creepy real fast. You will feel Kim's stress as weird things start happening around the home. At first, you might think it is just the ghost of the dead mother who is angry about being replaced, but the movie quickly shows you that something much worse is going on. It is a spooky ride that plays with your nerves and keeps you guessing about who is actually the villain.

The acting is solid and the scary parts really land because the story builds up the tension well. While some of the slower parts might feel a bit long, the big twists make it all worth it. You should definitely check this out if you love stories about family secrets and evil spirits. For the best experience, try renting it on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection so you can see all the creepy details clearly. It is the perfect flick for a rainy night when you want a good scare.
endingExplained: You find out that Na is not a loving stepmother but a witch who uses dark magic. She actually brought a demon into the house to take over. In the end, Kim discovers the truth and fights back against the evil forces. After a scary showdown, the demon is defeated and the dark spell is broken. Kim manages to save her father, and the family is finally free from the nightmare Na created.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves scary family secrets and ghost stories.
